description: CrossGL Translator and Compiler v0 language/IR fixture contract. Accepted fixtures pin current CrossTL AST hashes and compiler HIR hashes; grouped feature metadata cites docs/language/crosstl-frontend-language-spec-v0.json. Update with tools/check_cross_repo_language_contract.py --update-manifest after intentional frontend or HIR changes.

module_stages_and_entry_points.description: Shader modules, graphics/compute stage blocks, and named compute entry points accepted by the v0 frontend surface.

types_structs_arrays_and_constants.description: Primitive/vector/matrix/named types, structs, constants, and fixed/runtime array forms.

control_flow_and_statements.description: Branching, loops, scoped declarations, early returns, and statement AST forms shared by both frontends.

resources_layouts_and_storage.description: Layout metadata, descriptor resources, storage buffers/images, access qualifiers, and resource arrays.

textures_samplers_images_and_intrinsics.description: Texture/sampler/image resource types, shadow compare forms, LOD/manual compare helpers, and texture/image intrinsics.

descriptor_indexing_and_nonuniform.description: Descriptor arrays, symbolic/folded/dynamic descriptor indexes, nonuniform markers, and runtime array boundary cases.

expressions_operators_and_intrinsics.description: Arithmetic/comparison operators, casts, constructors, swizzles, loads/stores, and scalar/vector intrinsic calls.

crosstl_examples_and_backend_policy.description: Representative CrossTL example programs plus legal language forms that may remain target/backend unsupported.

spec_error.description: Small v0 error set. Some cases intentionally record current CrossTL acceptance so frontend/spec tightening remains visible without changing CrossTL in this branch.

cases.reason: A v0 shader must declare at least one compilable stage.

translator.note: Current CrossTL parser accepts this gap and returns a shader with no stages.

cases.reason: A v0 stage block must contain an explicit entry function.

translator.note: Current CrossTL parser synthesizes an empty void main for this form.

cases.reason: break is only legal inside loop constructs.

translator.note: Current CrossTL parser records the statement without placement validation.

cases.reason: Duplicate cbuffer member names are ambiguous in unqualified references.

spec_unsupported_for_native_v0.description: CrossTL-accepted source forms that the native v0 compiler frontend rejects with a stable unsupported diagnostic.

cases.reason: CrossTL accepts extended stages such as geometry, but native compiler v0 only lowers vertex, fragment, and compute stages.
CrossTL accepts ray any-hit stage blocks, but native compiler v0 only lowers vertex, fragment, and compute stages.
CrossTL accepts ray callable stage blocks, but native compiler v0 only lowers vertex, fragment, and compute stages.
CrossTL accepts ray closest-hit stage blocks, but native compiler v0 only lowers vertex, fragment, and compute stages.
CrossTL accepts ray generation stage blocks, but native compiler v0 only lowers vertex, fragment, and compute stages.
CrossTL accepts ray intersection stage blocks, but native compiler v0 only lowers vertex, fragment, and compute stages.
CrossTL accepts ray miss stage blocks, but native compiler v0 only lowers vertex, fragment, and compute stages.
CrossTL accepts tessellation stage blocks, but native compiler v0 only lowers vertex, fragment, and compute stages.
CrossTL accepts colon-style variable declarations; native compiler v0 accepts function-body colon-style locals but rejects stage-scope unqualified colon-style var declarations.
CrossTL accepts generic declarations, but native compiler v0 has no generic specialization or monomorphization path.
CrossTL accepts impl declarations, but native compiler v0 has no trait or impl lowering contract.
CrossTL accepts source import declarations, but native compiler v0 does not resolve source imports.
CrossTL accepts physical line-splicing tolerance before preprocessor/importer tokenization, but native compiler v0 does not promise backslash-newline splicing as shared .cgl syntax.
CrossTL accepts match/pattern control forms, but native compiler v0 does not lower them.
CrossTL accepts switch/case/default statements, but native compiler v0 only lowers the narrower control-flow subset covered by accepted fixtures.
CrossTL accepts loop statements, but native compiler v0 only lowers for and while loops.
CrossTL accepts do-while statements, but native compiler v0 only lowers for and while loops.
CrossTL accepts for-in loop statements, but native compiler v0 only lowers C-style for loops.
CrossTL accepts let mut declarations, but native compiler v0 only lowers C-style local declarations.
CrossTL accepts non-parenthesized if headers, but native compiler v0 requires the accepted fixture's parenthesized header form.
CrossTL accepts non-parenthesized while headers, but native compiler v0 requires the accepted fixture's parenthesized header form.
CrossTL accepts this incomplete for header shape, but native compiler v0 requires the accepted fixture's C-style init, condition, and update header form.
CrossTL accepts preprocessor nodes, but native compiler v0 does not run or preserve a source preprocessor.
CrossTL accepts trait declarations, but native compiler v0 has no trait or impl lowering contract.
CrossTL accepts broader var address-space declarations, but native compiler v0 only accepts workgroup/shared stage-scope var storage.
